## MMM_GEO_STRUCTURED_TIME_HOLDOUT_CERTIFICATION_001 — implementation evidence

- Milestone: bounded future-time, geo-holdout, and explicit short-history certification using existing H6/Ridge/CV entry points only.
- Branch: `feat/mmm-geo-structured-time-holdout-certification-001`.
- Evidence paths: `docs/05_validation/mmm_geo_structured_time_holdout_certification_001.md` and `docs/05_validation/archives/MMM_GEO_STRUCTURED_TIME_HOLDOUT_CERTIFICATION_001.json`.
- Primary finding: geo/Fourier improves several known-geo future predictions, but pooled media recovery is unstable across worlds and explicit short-history masking materially degrades structured-time behavior.
- Unseen geos are not supported by fixed geo effects; the zero-effect unseen-geo result is diagnostic only and no fallback was invented.
- No production Ridge/Bayesian behavior, retransformation, partial pooling, replay, optimizer/economics, Delta-mu authority, national policy, MIP, GeoX, DR-04, or release threshold changed.
- Exact deterministic evidence command is durable in report section 7 and archive provenance: `docker run --rm -e PYTHONPATH=/repo -v /tmp/holdout_run.py:/tmp/holdout_run.py -v /Users/phani/Desktop/MMM:/repo -w /repo mmm-fixture-ready:local python /tmp/holdout_run.py`.
- Focused H6/Ridge/CV tests, JSON/schema validation, documentation validation, taskctl, diff, and mandatory Docker gate are required before final publication.
- Proposed successors: matched-world structured-time holdout certification; unseen-geo fallback/partial-pooling certification; minimum-data policy study; held-out retransformation; independent Delta-mu and decision-invariance milestones.
- Unresolved execution-blocking design questions: none.
